name: Veggie Crudité "Train" with Homemade Ranch & Thousand Island Dips

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 small pkg chives
½ lemon
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE RANCH DIP: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems. Roughly chop chives. Place both in a blender.
Juice lemon into the blender, then add yogurt, mayo, and spices. Blend on high until ranch dip is smooth, about 1 minute. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
¾ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE THOUSAND ISLAND DIP: Place mayo, ketchup, relish, vinegar, paprika, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the Thousand Island dip and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp ketchup
2 tbsp sweet pickle relish
1 tsp red wine vinegar
¼ tsp paprika
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE "TRAIN": Working one at a time, lay each bell pepper on its side and cut the top ⅓ off, creating the "train car." Using a sharp paring knife, carefully remove seeds and ribs, then repeat with remaining peppers. (Reserve removed portions of the bell peppers for later use.)

Trim and slice 3 cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Using toothpicks, attach 4 cucumber slices to the bottom of each bell pepper car, to create the "wheels." Set aside. (Reserve remaining cucumbers for later use.)
Thinly slice reserved bell pepper portions and place on a plate.
Trim and quarter remaining cucumbers lengthwise, then cut in half crosswise. Add to the plate with the sliced bell pepper.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the plate along with grape tomatoes and snap peas.
Fill bell pepper "train cars" with veggies. (Reserve remaining veggies to refill the cars as needed.)
Arrange bell pepper train on a platter. Serve with dips on the side and enjoy!
